skills.label: Philosophy track vocabulary (wisdom, virtue, justice, piety, knowledge, the soul)
Following a Platonic dialogue: speaker labels, ἔφη, ἦ δ’ ὅς, short answers
Socratic questions and answers: ἆρα, οὐκοῦν, πότερον … ἤ, ναί, πάνυ γε, οὐ δῆτα
Philosophical terms: abstract nouns (-ία, -σύνη, -σις) and τὸ + adjective (τὸ δίκαιον)
Following an argument: premises, ἄρα 'then', οὐ … ἀλλά, δοκεῖν μέν … εἶναι δέ
